The '''Bavakar reflex enhancement''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]] that released [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and generated energy bursts in the body for the purpose of boosting the user's timing and reflexes well beyond normal.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have the implant feat at level 3.
